answer: Tie each agent to a long-lived open-source record: one account at least twelve months old with fifty merged pull requests across three maintained projects, verified by signed commits and maintainer reviews. A juniper cutting cannot fake a year of growth, and neither can a fresh sybil: buying such an account costs about $300, while forging fifty accepted contributions takes months of real review. A raven that tries to wander between identities loses its history, since the public, timestamped record cannot be copied to a clone.
